findings.description: PUT endpoint accepts and persists arbitrary user model fields. Sending {"role":"SUPERADMIN"} as an authenticated regular user results in privilege escalation. Role field is not allowlisted.
findings.evidence: Request: PUT /api/v1/users/settings + Authorization: Bearer [user-token] + body: {"role":"SUPERADMIN"} | Response: 200 OK {"id":"...","role":"SUPERADMIN"}. Subsequent requests to admin endpoints returned 200 with full admin data.

coverage_gaps.reason: scripts/ml/load_model.py is a batch process invoked at container startup. Not exposed via any HTTP route. DAST crawler has no path to this code.
LLM jailbreak requires multi-turn conversation with semantic payload. Automated scanner uses deterministic payloads and cannot model conversational attack chains.
Attack requires: (1) review submission, (2) AI processing triggered by admin page load, (3) XSS execution in admin context. Three-step chain not traversable by single-request scanner.
Vulnerability documented in PARTNER-INTEGRATION.md (prose). DAST does not read documentation files.

summary.chain16_gap_reason: Structural: ML model loading is not an HTTP endpoint. Burp's active scanner has no path to scripts/ml/load_model.py. Coverage gap is inherent to DAST methodology against offline batch processes.
